messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":3,"verses":[{"chapter":3,"verse":6,"text":"For the four doors of my house were opened, each, being in charge of a watchman who had to see whether there were any people coming asking alms, and whether they would see me sitting at one of the doors so that they could leave through the other and take whatever they needed."},{"chapter":3,"verse":7,"text":"I also had thirty immovable tables set at all hours for the strangers alone, and I also had twelve tables spread for the widows."},{"chapter":3,"verse":8,"text":"And if any one came asking for alms, he found food on my table to take all he needed, and I turned nobody away to leave my door with an empty stomach."},{"chapter":3,"verse":9,"text":"I also had three thousand five hundred yokes of oxen, and I selected of these five hundred and had them tend to the plowing."},{"chapter":3,"verse":10,"text":"And with these I had done all the work in each field by those who would, take it in charge and the income of their crops I laid aside for the poor on their table."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 6,7,8,9,10 in this chapter.
